_note: Material assignment for V18 printed parts plus structural densities. Rules are matched in order against the print template name; the first match wins. Densities marked 'assumed' must be replaced by measured values (config/measurements.json stage1.lwpla_effective_density_g_cm3 overrides LW-PLA).

LW-PLA.basis: assumed planning value; best case 0.60, fully dense PLA 1.24

rules.why: charcoal covers - change to PETG if they must take screw loads
V18: PETG fittings - trays, cassettes, cradle, saddles, ducts

carbon_tube._note: Pultruded square tube, ~1 mm wall candidate. Mass per metre = (outer^2 - (outer - 2 t)^2) x density.
